source_limitations: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary pages were directly opened for sense and grammar. Cambridge exact-sense labels were observed in public indexed publisher results; direct Cambridge requests returned HTTP 403. Oxford topic CEFR tags are not word/sense CEFR evidence. Neither research nor suggested Myanmar/examples constitutes independent human approval.

frozen_original.english_definition: To guide and control an activity.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ညွှန်ကြားသည်၊ ဦးဆောင်သည်
frozen_original.example_sentence: She will direct the school play.

oxford_direct.scope: Sense 1 managing activities versus sense 2 directing actors or a play

records.evidence_note: Frozen English definition matches broad management/control, but the example is specifically directing a school play. Cambridge-indexed C1 control versus B1 film/play makes this a high-priority definition/example mismatch, not an approved level change.
records.proposed_english_definition: To guide the actors and the performance of a play or film.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: ပြဇာတ် သို့မဟုတ် ရုပ်ရှင်တွင် သရုပ်ဆောင်များ၏ သရုပ်ဆောင်ပုံကို ညွှန်ကြားသည်။
records.proposed_original_example: Maya will direct the school play next term.

frozen_original.english_definition: A written message that gives information or instructions.
frozen_original.example_sentence: A notice on the door says the office is closed.

oxford_direct.scope: Countable public written notice or sign, distinct from uncountable advance warning

records.evidence_note: Frozen B1 noun definition and posted-door example both refer to a countable written sign; Cambridge-indexed A2 is for that exact sense, while B1 is a different uncountable advance-warning sense. Human reviewer must adjudicate quota movement or alternate sense.
records.proposed_english_definition: A written sign or message displayed to give information or instructions.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: အများမြင်နိုင်သောနေရာတွင် ကပ်ထားသည့် အသိပေးစာ သို့မဟုတ် ညွှန်ကြားချက်ပါသော ဆိုင်းဘုတ်။
records.proposed_original_example: The notice by the entrance says the library closes at six.

frozen_original.english_definition: An activity or set of activities involved in running something.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: လုပ်ငန်းဆောင်ရွက်မှု
frozen_original.example_sentence: The warehouse operation begins at eight o'clock.

oxford_direct.scope: Business organisation (countable) versus business activities (usually plural) versus functioning (uncountable)

records.evidence_note: Frozen B1 general definition and singular 'warehouse operation' example do not uniquely specify company, daily business activities or a discrete organised task. Cambridge-indexed C1 work senses are leads, not proof that this exact warehouse example is C1. Oxford business activity often uses plural operations.
records.proposed_english_definition: The activities involved in running a business or part of a business, often used in the plural.
records.proposed_myanmar_meaning: လုပ်ငန်းတစ်ခု သို့မဟုတ် ဌာနတစ်ခု၏ နေ့စဉ် လုပ်ငန်းဆောင်ရွက်မှုများ။
records.proposed_original_example: The company's warehouse operations begin at eight each morning.

frozen_original.english_definition: Connected with ordinary citizens rather than the military.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: အရပ်ဘက်ဆိုင်ရာ
frozen_original.example_sentence: The group works to protect civil rights.

oxford_direct.scope: Citizens of a country versus state/non-military versus law versus polite

records.evidence_note: Frozen definition contrasts civilians with the military, while the example 'civil rights' concerns citizens' legal rights; the non-military gloss alone is insufficient to teach the collocation. Oxford's 'Religion and festivals b2' is a topic label, not headword or exact-sense CEFR evidence. No publisher word-sense CEFR label was verified for this card.
records.proposed_english_definition: Connected with citizens and their rights in society, rather than with the armed forces.
records.proposed_original_example: The group campaigns to protect civil rights.
